sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Woods is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the third map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Woods is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Features
sections.text:
- Stationary weapons in the form of NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine guns.
- Be aware of Border Snipers and Minefields!

sections.heading: Bosses
sections.text:
Seasonal change: Black Division can occasionally roam through the map. They do not have a fixed spawn location and have to be expected everywhere.
| Name | Location | Notable equipment | Followers |

| Knight | At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction). | Death Knight mask; Crye Precision CPC plate carrier (Goons Edition) | Big Pipe, Birdeye |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The location was first expanded with patch 0.6.0.861 on January 19, 2018.
- The location was expanded for the second time with patch 0.12.9.10423 on December 24, 2020. Notably adding the Old Sawmill, which is a standalone map in Escape from Tarkov's predecessors, Contract Wars and Hired Ops, and was also later introduced to Arena.
- The location was expanded again with patch 0.16.0.0.34447 on December 26, 2024.
